articles.title: Bitcoin price taps $65.5K as Iran deal sees oil drop toward 16-week low
articles.snippet: Bitcoin sought a breakout toward a potential BTC price target near $70,000 as Iran news sent oil toward its lowest levels since early March.

articles.title: These XRP price charts hint at potential 25% relief rally in July
articles.snippet: An XRP death cross and liquidation signals align for a possible 25% relief rally in the short term, while one analyst eyes a longer-term rebound toward $8.

articles.title: Bitcoin tipped for $66K top as trader flags 'suspicious' BTC price gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin pushed for a $64,000 reclaim despite the US-Iran war making a partial comeback and Binance spot sellers keeping up pressure from earlier in the week.

articles.title: The Studio Behind 'Ex Machina' Is Now Researching AI With Google
articles.snippet: Google is investing $75 million in A24 as part of a new AI research initiative focused on filmmaking tools.

articles.title: House Republican Introduces Insider Trading Bill to Ban Lawmaker Prediction Market Bets
articles.snippet: The bill is meant to curb potential insider trading, blocking lawmakers and family members from policy-related prediction market bets.
